verdict.line: You lose if you brawl Illaoi near Tentacles or walk into Test of Spirit unprepared; you win if you dictate trades with Q's stun and E's poke until Thornmail/Bramble Vest and R's tower-disable take over.

brief.thesis: Illaoi's whole kit is built to force stand-and-fight trades near Tentacles (spawned on impassible terrain by her passive, Prophet of an Elder God) and inside her E (Test of Spirit, 900 range), both of which punish Volibear for brawling in the wrong spot or at the wrong time. Volibear's stun (Q, Thundering Smash, 300 range) and sustain (W, Frenzied Maul double-cast heal) only matter if he picks the fight location and timing instead of being pulled into one, which is exactly why OP.GG logs this as a lane and solo-kill deficit for Illaoi despite Volibear sitting at an even 50.4% win rate over 121 games overall.

theirWindow.when: After she lands Test of Spirit
theirWindow.what: The spirit echoes damage back to you and risks turning you into a tentacle-spawning Vessel if you overchase or drift too far from it; disengage onto minions or a jungle camp and let the timer run out instead of forcing a continued fight.

yourWindow.when: Her W (Harsh Lesson) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Step into trade range with Q (Thundering Smash) for the stun or poke with E (Sky Splitter) — without her short 4s-cooldown leap backing up Tentacle Smash, she has no counter-engage for several seconds.

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: The regen and mana sustain (with two potions) let you weather the early poke from her W (Harsh Lesson) and Tentacles without recalling, and it's the most-run start in this matchup at 71.3% pick.

boots.why: Flat damage reduction blunts her autos and physical-damage Tentacle Smash/Harsh Lesson procs better than Mercury's Treads, matching the 59.2% pick rate here.

core.why: Armor plus a bleed effect cuts into the healing Illaoi gets whenever her Tentacles damage a champion (Prophet of an Elder God) — this is OP.GG's own direct counter-pick for the matchup.
The most-picked core item in this matchup (11.2% pick) — keeps your damage relevant into the midgame skirmishes once lane is over.
Attack speed scaling feeds Volibear's passive (The Relentless Storm), so your double-cast W (Frenzied Maul) and auto resets land faster in extended trades.
Armor plus damage reflect caps out the anti-physical build, since every one of Illaoi's tools — Q, W, R, and her Tentacles — is physical damage.

situational.when: the enemy team adds real magic damage or extra healing you need to cut into
you're already ahead and want wave-clear and poke over a straight brawl
you're snowballing and need burst to finish squishy backline targets

runes.keystoneWhy: Grasp procs off the auto and W (Frenzied Maul) hits you're already landing in extended trades, and this page measures an 58.8% win rate here — well above the Lethal Tempo page's 46.9% — because it's built to out-sustain exactly the kind of poke-and-tentacle chip damage Illaoi applies in a lane she's favored in.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is both the most-run pairing (80% pick) and sits at an even 50% win rate; Ignite punishes her all-in attempts off W (Harsh Lesson) resets and denies the healing her Tentacles give back, which matters since you're behind on solo-kill potential per the matchup data. Flash+Teleport (33.3% WR, 9.1% pick) is the alternative if you'd rather scale through side-lane pressure instead of contesting kills.

playing.title: Hold Q until she commits
playing.detail: Thundering Smash (Q, 300 range, 12-10s CD) only stuns the first enemy you attack, so wait for her to walk into melee with W (Harsh Lesson, 4s CD, 400 range) before you spend it — don't throw it preemptively into a minion.

playing.title: Fight away from walls
playing.detail: Tentacles spawn on nearby impassible terrain, so pulling trades off the river or jungle wall removes her extra tentacle swings and the healing her passive (Prophet of an Elder God) grants off them.

playing.title: Don't chase through Test of Spirit
playing.detail: If she rips your spirit with E (900 range, 16-12s CD), closing the gap just re-engages a fight on her terms; disengage and reset since staying too far from the spirit or letting it die risks turning you into a tentacle-spawning Vessel.

playing.title: Use E to zone, not just burst
playing.detail: Sky Splitter (E, 1200 range, 16s CD) slows and shields you if you stand in its own blast, so you can poke her approach without ever walking into Harsh Lesson range.

playing.title: Save R for siege windows
playing.detail: Stormbringer (R, 160/135/110s CD) temporarily disables nearby enemy towers on landing, so hold it for a dive or tower push rather than a lane skirmish — the long early cooldown means you don't get it back for a while.

playing.title: Always double-tap W
playing.detail: Frenzied Maul (W, 5s CD) marks on the first hit; the second cast on the same target deals bonus damage and heals you, so land both casts in every extended trade to offset her tentacle sustain.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/sample numbers are pulled from measured games on the current patch (16.20.1); the mechanical reasoning — why the trades, timings, and positioning work the way they do — is my own read on the two kits, not OP.GG's.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being hit with Illaoi’s (E) in line. Purchase Bramble Vest and use [E] to contest lane while waiting for the enemy’s skills to be on cooldown.
